role.zh: 机械研发工程师 / 结构设计

usageNote.zh: 本人授权用于个人职业作品集
usageNote.en: Authorized for use in this personal professional portfolio

title.zh: 把复杂约束转化为可制造、可验证的结构方案
title.en: Turning complex constraints into manufacturable, verifiable structures

summary.zh: 约四年汽车电子产品开发经验，覆盖冲压、压铸与注塑壳体，以及尺寸链、热管理和量产问题闭环。
summary.en: Around four years of automotive electronics development experience across stamped, die-cast, and injection-molded housings, tolerance analysis, thermal management, and production issue closure.

paragraphs.zh: 具备材料科学与机械工程中法双学位背景，能够从材料、结构、工艺和装配边界协同分析产品问题。
paragraphs.en: Sino-French dual-degree training in materials science and mechanical engineering supports cross-functional analysis of materials, structures, processes, and assembly interfaces.

paragraphs.zh: 工作经历集中于汽车电子控制器结构开发和量产导入，并持续拓展机器人与自动化设备结构设计能力。
paragraphs.en: Experience centers on structural development and production launch for automotive electronic controllers, with a growing focus on structural design for robotics and automation equipment.

summary.zh: 参与项目产品工程与交付流程，协同处理工程信息、变更和问题闭环。
summary.en: Supporting product engineering and delivery processes, with coordination across engineering information, changes, and issue closure.

highlights.zh: 在跨团队流程中维护结构化的工程信息与交付节奏
highlights.en: Maintaining structured engineering information and delivery cadence across teams

highlights.zh: 围绕产品问题协调评审、跟踪与闭环
highlights.en: Coordinating review, tracking, and closure of product issues

summary.zh: 负责汽车电子控制器壳体与安装绝缘结构开发，覆盖概念设计、详细设计、验证支持和量产问题闭环。
summary.en: Developed housings, mounting structures, and insulation concepts for automotive electronic controllers from concept and detailed design through validation support and production issue closure.

highlights.zh: 跨电子、热管理、制造与供应商团队推进结构方案
highlights.en: Advanced mechanical concepts with electronics, thermal, manufacturing, and supplier teams

highlights.zh: 运用 GD&T、尺寸链、热分析与模流结果支持设计决策
highlights.en: Used GD&T, tolerance analysis, thermal studies, and mold-flow results to support design decisions

title.zh: D5 PDCU 平台应用与问题闭环
title.en: D5 PDCU Platform Applications and Issue Closure

summary.zh: 支持华为、吉利和长安相关平台应用中的结构适配与量产问题分析，推动跨团队闭环。
summary.en: Supported structural application work and production issue analysis for platform programs associated with Huawei, Geely, and Changan, coordinating cross-team closure.

contributions.zh: 分析结构接口、装配边界与问题影响范围
contributions.en: Analyzed structural interfaces, assembly boundaries, and issue impact

contributions.zh: 协同设计、制造、质量和供应链推进验证与闭环
contributions.en: Coordinated design, manufacturing, quality, and supply-chain validation and closure

title.zh: D3 ECU 冲压壳体与热管理
title.en: D3 ECU Stamped Housing and Thermal Management

summary.zh: 围绕冲压上下壳体、连接器与绝缘导热结构开展设计，并结合热分析优化散热路径。
summary.en: Developed stamped upper and lower housings, connector interfaces, and insulation-conduction structures, using thermal analysis to improve heat paths.

contributions.zh: 评估冲压成形、装配与密封相关结构边界
contributions.en: Assessed stamping, assembly, and sealing-related structural constraints

contributions.zh: 支持连接器选型与绝缘导热方案协同
contributions.en: Supported connector selection and insulation-conduction concept coordination

title.zh: TCU 压铸上壳体与 PCB 协同
title.en: TCU Die-Cast Upper Housing and PCB Coordination

summary.zh: 负责压铸上壳体结构设计，协调 PCB、紧固、安装和制造边界。
summary.en: Developed a die-cast upper housing while coordinating PCB, fastening, mounting, and manufacturing constraints.

contributions.zh: 建立壳体、PCB 与紧固系统的关键接口
contributions.en: Defined key interfaces among the housing, PCB, and fastening system

contributions.zh: 支持结构评审与可制造性问题处理
contributions.en: Supported structural reviews and manufacturability issue resolution

title.zh: BMS 与 CSC 注塑壳体开发
title.en: BMS and CSC Injection-Molded Housing Development

summary.zh: 开展塑料壳体、安装与卡扣结构设计，结合尺寸链和模流结果优化筋位与装配稳定性。
summary.en: Developed plastic housings, mounting features, and snap-fit structures, using tolerance chains and mold-flow results to refine ribs and assembly stability.

contributions.zh: 搭建关键尺寸链并识别装配风险
contributions.en: Built key tolerance chains and identified assembly risks

contributions.zh: 依据模流结果调整筋位与局部结构
contributions.en: Adjusted ribs and local geometry using mold-flow findings

title.zh: BMS 样件与材料技术支持
title.en: BMS Prototype and Material Technical Support

summary.zh: 为代工项目提供材料选择、样件评审与结构问题支持，衔接设计意图与制造反馈。
summary.en: Provided material selection, prototype review, and structural issue support for contract-manufacturing work, connecting design intent with manufacturing feedback.

contributions.zh: 支持材料方案比较与样件状态评审
contributions.en: Supported material-option comparison and prototype-status reviews

contributions.zh: 整理制造反馈并推进结构问题闭环
contributions.en: Structured manufacturing feedback and advanced mechanical issue closure

summary.zh: 围绕上下壳体与 PCB 的固定关系，通过条形槽和卡接结构兼顾安装可靠性与电气爬电距离。
summary.en: Addresses the relationship among upper and lower housings and a PCB, using a strip groove and snap-fit features to support assembly reliability and electrical creepage distance.

items.en: Supplier technical communication and prototype tracking

degree.en: Bachelor of Engineering in Materials Science and Engineering

summary.zh: 材料、制造与机械基础训练，为结构设计中的材料选择和工艺判断建立基础。
summary.en: Training in materials, manufacturing, and mechanical fundamentals supports material and process decisions in structural design.

summary.zh: 在跨文化课程环境中完成机械工程训练，形成中英法多语言协作基础。
summary.en: Completed mechanical engineering study in a cross-cultural program, building a foundation for collaboration in Chinese, English, and French.
